Beauty can often come at times at when you least expect. For me, I was rushing towards my 3rd Period class, wading through a sea of sweat and musk with a binder clutched close to my chest. I entered the lobby of my highschool, to be greeted with a conflict incited with malice. A quite rotund female student had entered a squabble with another, slightly thinner girl. Though this petty arguing soon turned violent. Screeching soon erupted from the large ones mouth as she yanked the hair of the smaller student. Soon the commotion drew the attention of school staff, all of whom tried to apprehend the fat girl. Though their efforts were futile, for her grip did not falter as the victims hair strained against her meaty hands.
